name: rise-lagos
description: Rise: Hustle or Die Trying — Unity edition (unity/), shared map and content data (src/data) and the Next.js site (web/)

scripts.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'data modules OK' && node scripts/check-data.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --include=dev && npm --prefix web run build
